statement: The inverse limit of all dihedral GT_0 shadows is (product over odd p of Aff(Z_p)) times H_2 and contains elements of every prime order, with explicit compatible prime-dependent multipliers. Full GT_0 torsion of multiplier one is exactly an automorphism-and-cycle-and-nonabelian-norm problem for f in the residual kernel R of Fhat_2→product F_2^(p); this R surjects onto A_5.
notes: Proves the exact limitation of the entire all-prime dihedral system by a continuous CRT isomorphism and compatible infinite prime-order examples. No surjectivity of GT_0 onto the whole inverse limit and no torsion lift are asserted. D.32 subsequently proves that the multiplier-one automorphism, cycle, and norm equations have only f=1; every odd-prime torsion point exhibited in the dihedral limit therefore fails an order-preserving lift to full GT_0.
